convergence.interpretation: Near a plateau under the completed OneCycle schedule; not proof of absolute convergence. Simply appending epochs at the final learning rate is not a useful continuation test.

protocol.hsm: Observed adaptive moments; central 105 or 155 target-pixel crops, matched native footprints; masks; central radius 25 coverage; max centroid offset 10 target pixels. No PSF correction.
protocol.background: Measurement-only signed offsets ±0.1 times per-object outer sky RMS; not calibrated background uncertainty. NISP offsets affect only native/interpolated baseline measurements; SR/JWST offsets affect that image only.
protocol.noise: Add independent Gaussian noise of 0.25 times supplied NISP pixel RMS to valid input pixels, re-run SR and interpolation; three fixed seeds. A 6.25% variance increase under an independent-noise approximation; no JWST noise model.
protocol.crowding: Input-only local peak above 5 RMS at radius 3–9 NISP pixels; proxy, not a deblender or isolation certification.
protocol.population: Within each scenario methods share successes; compare with nominal on their common IDs; also report intersection of all scenarios. Never tune scenarios against results.

common_ids_location: runs/shape-robustness-best49/report.json; measurements.npz includes object_ids and global_common
